evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: The directive appeals to self-origination — commanding what to discard from one's own knowledge base.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Imperative to selectively erase specific knowledge appeals to self-directed control over what is retained.
Asserts a stable historical record — what did and did not happen — appealing to keeping the record straight.
